transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Um... well, I guess I'm here because... things have just been a little difficult lately. I recently tried to clean up my image and, like, my daily routine for some arts board stuff. But since I started doing that, I've been a lot more tense and down than I expected to be. 

I mean... I'm still getting the basics done. But I just keep dropping little things I normally care about... like my design drafts, or notes for fair planning. And then I just... I don't know, I feel guilty about it, so I end up canceling plans instead of actually catching up. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have you noticed that you’re not enjoying things as much as you used to, or that you’ve lost interest in your usual activities?
Um... no, I don't think so. I still care about my usual stuff. I just... haven't been getting to it as much lately. But I haven't really lost interest.
Have you been feeling more tired or lacking energy lately, even if you’re not doing much different than before?
Um... no, not really. I mean, I guess I'm a little tired sometimes, but... not more than usual, I don't think. My energy's fine.
Have you been feeling like you’re not good enough or that you’re letting others down, even when you’re doing your best?
Um... no, not really. I mean... I feel bad when I cancel plans, like I said before. But... I don't really feel like I'm not good enough, or anything like that. Just... behind.
Have you noticed yourself doing significantly fewer things in your daily life or feeling less involved in activities that usually matter to you?
Um... I don't think so. I mean, I'm still doing my normal stuff. Just... maybe not as often, like I said. But I'm still doing things.
Have you noticed that your thoughts feel slower than usual, or that you're moving more slowly, even when you're trying to get things done?
No, I haven't noticed anything like that. My thoughts are... fine. I don't feel like I'm moving slow or anything. Just normal, I guess.
Do you find yourself feeling sad or down most of the day, nearly every day?
Um... no, not really. I mean, I have moments where I feel a little down, but... not most of the day. And definitely not every day.
Do you find yourself feeling worried or tense most days, even when there's not a specific problem happening?
No... I wouldn't say that. I mean, I worry sometimes, just like normal, but usually there's an actual reason for it. I don't just feel tense all the time for no reason.
Do you ever feel like your worries are bigger than the actual problem, or that you're more tense than the situation really calls for?
I don't think so. I mean, when I worry, it feels... justified, I guess. It doesn't seem like an overreaction to me.
Have you noticed that your worry or tension feels out of proportion to the actual problem, like it's more intense or lasts longer than the situation seems to call for?
Um... no. Like I just said, I don't really think so. It just... it feels like a normal amount to me. Not really out of proportion or anything.
Do you find it hard to control your worry, even when you know it might not be as big a deal as you're making it out to be?
No, not really. I mean... if I'm worried about something, it's usually because it is a big deal to me. I don't really sit around feeling like I can't control it.
Do you find yourself worrying about multiple different things, even when you're trying to focus on just one problem at a time?
Um, no. Not really. I just... if there's an issue, I just focus on that one thing, I guess. It's not like my mind is jumping around to a bunch of different things all at once.
Do you find that you worry a lot about everyday things, even when they aren’t major problems, and does it feel hard to stop worrying about them?
No... not really. I mean, if it's just an everyday thing, I don't really worry about it. It's just normal stuff. So, no, it's not hard to stop or anything.

Have you been worrying more than usual about different things in your life, like work, relationships, or other everyday issues, and has this been happening more days than not for at least the past six months?
Um, no. Not really. I don't think I worry about everything like that... and definitely not for six months. So, no.
Do you find that you worry a lot about specific things in your life, and once you start worrying about them, it's hard to stop even if you try?
Not really, no. I mean... if I'm worried about something, it's usually just because there's a reason to be. It's not like I get stuck on it and can't stop.
Do you often feel very anxious or worried about specific events or tasks, like upcoming deadlines or responsibilities, even if they’re not urgent?
Um... no. I don't think so. If something isn't urgent, I don't really worry about it. Plus, I don't really have deadlines right now anyway... so, no.
Do you find that you avoid starting or joining activities because you feel too tense or guilty about falling behind, even though you know they’re important to you?

Um... yeah, I guess so. That's kind of why I came in, actually. I’ve been trying to, like, clean up my routine and my image for some arts board stuff... but I've just been feeling more tense and down than I expected. 

I mean, I'm still doing the basic stuff, but I keep dropping little things I usually care about... like my fair planning notes, or design drafts. And then... yeah, I feel guilty about it. So I just end up canceling plans instead of trying to catch up.
Have your feelings of tension and guilt been causing you a lot of distress or making it hard for you to do things you need to do in your daily life, like work or spending time with others?

Um... I mean, I'm still getting through my basic errands and regular commitments. It's not like I can't function. I've just been... I guess less reliable lately. Like with the volunteer stuff and the creative roles people usually count on me for... the fair planning, or following through on those designs. I just haven't been keeping up with them as much.
Have these feelings of tension and guilt been happening on most days, and have they been going on for at least a few weeks?
Um... yeah, I guess most days. It's been... about two months now. Just since I decided to, you know, overhaul everything with my routine and how I present myself.
